principles: Exactly three existing hosted roles; remote specialists, never production local fallbacks.
Deterministic authorization, prerequisite and finish gates precede semantic Microsoft-Decision-1 choices.
Independent conversations, MAF checkpoints and Blob effects/artifacts are distinct state planes.
Only exact immutable inputs and current approving review can authorize accepted advisory output.
Current observations establish blockers; local checks never establish deployed acceptance.
Preserve pinned sessions and unknown-effect holds; never resend merely because logs or a process are absent.

components.name: Existing-project azd delivery
components.remaining: Replace the three incompatible predeploy hooks with ordinary exclusion/dependency/build checks; retain unused legacy package_guard safeguards. Deploy and verify exact revisions under the shared environment lock.

components.name: MAF coordinator and gated routing
components.remaining: Exercise genuine Decision-1 alternatives after deterministic gates; verify current exact producer/prerequisite bindings and finish semantics.

components.name: Remote design and revision agent
components.remaining: Collect a real first candidate and a changed immutable candidate responding to actual reviewer findings from the same remote child.

components.name: Remote exact-candidate review agent
components.remaining: Collect first findings and a fresh review of the exact revised candidate; approval cannot coexist with blockers or unresolved requirements.

components.name: Private shared artifact plane
components.remaining: Verify private DNS/path, actual MI reads/writes, immutable provenance and fenced coordinator publication in the existing environment.

components.name: Parent-bound continuity and safe recovery
components.remaining: Verify same-parent history/checkpoints and known-response recovery without duplicate sends, supported hosted-session stop/resume, and a second isolated parent. Preserve unknown effects.

components.name: Synthetic terminal acceptance surface
components.remaining: Run the fresh design-review-revision and completed same-parent follow-up; expose actual accepted artifact/decision evidence with canonical component RAG.

flows.name: Synthetic design, review and revision
flows.trigger: A new authenticated synthetic request in the existing nonproduction project.

steps.description: Terminal sends stored background input to the pinned coordinator; trusted hosting context binds principal/project/tenant/parent and publishes immutable requirements.
MAF begin/route checks current refs and deterministic gates; journal and validate a calibrated Decision-1 choice between the permitted specialist action and request_input. Low confidence holds.

Create or restore the independently bound architect child; write intent/assignment before dispatch. Architect reads exact requirements, writes immutable design, and coordinator validates provenance before ETag publication.

Remote reviewer reads exact requirements/design and returns real findings. Architect receives that prior design/review and emits a new candidate; reviewer reviews that exact revision. Repeat only through valid gates.

Only current approving review with no blockers/unresolved requirements finishes; terminal exposes accepted refs, decisions and truthful component status. Advisory design acceptance is not application release approval.

flows.name: Same-parent follow-up and supported recovery
flows.trigger: A completed parent's follow-up, or recovery of its persisted pending response.

steps.description: Reuse the pinned parent and both child identities/model histories; append changed requirements, invalidate stale candidate/review, and run design-review-revision again. Do not follow up a held turn.
Retrieve known responses, restore native graph checkpoints and reconcile journal/output/manifest. Unknown external effects stay held; missing observations are not never-sent proof.

Use only the supported scoped hosted-session compute stop/resume acceptance and durable marker; compare retained volume/checkpoints, pinned bindings and independently captured sends. This is not infrastructure VM power or hard-crash proof.

flows.name: Independent synthetic parent isolation
flows.trigger: A second independently authenticated synthetic parent requests a different design.

steps.description: Derive a distinct trusted-parent namespace and separate child conversations; never accept supplied session IDs as access grants.
Compare exact artifacts, prerequisites and child bindings and test rejection of cross-parent access plus absence of the first parent's synthetic context.

flows.name: Walking skeleton and exact candidate deployment
flows.trigger: The DevOps owner receives a committed candidate for existing-environment verification.

steps.description: Pin the feature-branch commit or immutable artifact, validate settings/authentication and ordinary package/dependency/build exclusions without reading secrets or requiring legacy approval receipts.
DevOps holds the shared environment lock and runs normal azd deploy to exactly three existing roles, recording actual operation outcomes and deployed versions.
E2E verifies that exact candidate while the lock is held, joins private source-bound observations, and returns deployed results before original assignment review/acceptance and dependent release.

statePlanes.name: Conversations
statePlanes.contract: Parent, both hosted/framework child bindings and each specialist model history remain independent; versions pin within a parent, response IDs advance.

statePlanes.name: MAF checkpoints
statePlanes.contract: Restore supported graph/executor state, never infer external exactly-once effects from checkpoint completion.

statePlanes.name: Blob artifacts and write-ahead effects
statePlanes.contract: ScopeBinding(project,tenant,principal,parent); ArtifactRef(container,name,sha256,type,revisions); producer(role,name,version,session,response); exact input refs; assignment operation/hash; effect transitions and fenced accepted manifest.

containers.purpose: Requirements, decisions, assignments, child refs, operation journal and manifest; separate coordinator admission control.
Immutable candidate designs scoped to exact requirements and previous accepted review.
Immutable findings and approval for the exact requirements/candidate revision.

contracts.identityAndNetwork: Managed identity accesses Blob over verified private DNS/IP bindings. Hosting propagates the genuine user; assignment receiver validates principal, child, pinned version, exact refs, active operation and deadline. Exact-origin transport never substitutes a principal. Existing account-wide Blob Contributor means app-enforced ownership, not per-role storage isolation. No RBAC/network changes.
contracts.compatibility: Keep Responses 2.0.0 and requirements/lock pins authoritative. Inspect a current failed boundary before selecting a supported remedy. Major host/transport changes require an explicit scoped requirements decision and compatibility tests; old sessions stay pinned or use an explicit migration. Never edit SDK journals.

deliveryHandoff.candidate: Exact committed feature/azd-demo-delivery revision or immutable artifact, not a mutable checkout.
deliveryHandoff.acceptance: Every assignment requires passing deployed verification: DevOps then E2E under one lock before original reviewers/acceptance/dependent release. Construction emits local checks and exact revision, never mutates the shared environment.
deliveryHandoff.continuation: Localize failed criteria; continue independent approved work without releasing failed prerequisites. Replan material dependency/contract/scope changes only through existing roles. No new audit or disposition stage.

verification.deployedProof: Separate actual azd command outcome and successful deployed probe for early skeleton and exact integrated candidate; join revision/artifact to all three versions.
Genuine Decision-1 response/probabilities/calibration/input refs after deterministic gates; trusted scope and current approved finish plus negative stale/principal checks.
Real remote first design and changed revised candidate bound to exact assigned requirements/prior findings and the same architect child.
Real first findings, revised exact-candidate review, and current approving review without blockers/unresolved requirements; no fabricated approval.
Actual private MI Blob exchange, content hashes, exact refs/producer bindings, immutable role output and coordinator lease/ETag results; honest account-wide RBAC limitation.

Source-bound initial/followup/restart/isolated observations plus stopped_session joined by validate_scenario_evidence; direct history controls, known-response recovery and no extra creates/sends. Unknown effects remain held.
Fresh terminal design-review-revision and same-parent follow-up expose accepted exact artifacts/decisions and seven-component RAG; SDK completion is insufficient.
